blocks.en: So far in this chapter, we have discussed only Dirichlet boundary conditions for elliptic problems. In this section we shall discuss a few of the other boundary conditions that arise in physical and mathematical problems. Since physical problems present us with a wide variety of boundary conditions for consideration our discussion will not be exhaustive.
blocks.zh: 本章至今只讨论了椭圆问题的 Dirichlet 边界条件. 本节讨论物理与数学问题中出现的其他几种边界条件. 由于物理问题提出了种类繁多的边界条件, 这里的讨论并不穷尽所有情形.

blocks.en: After the Dirichlet problem, the second most common and important elliptic boundary-value problem is the Neumann problem.
blocks.zh: 在 Dirichlet 问题之后, 第二种最常见且重要的椭圆边值问题是 Neumann 问题.

blocks.en: As with the Dirichlet problem, we can define a strong solution of the Neumann problem.
blocks.zh: 与 Dirichlet 问题一样, 可以定义 Neumann 问题的强解.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ be a bounded domain with a $C^1$ boundary and suppose $f\in L^2(\Omega)$ is given. A function\[u\in H^2(\Omega)\]is a \textbf{strong solution} of the Neumann problem if \eqref{eq:neumann-classical-divergence-equation} holds in $L^2(\Omega)$ and \eqref{eq:neumann-homogeneous-conormal-boundary-condition} holds in the sense of trace on $\partial\Omega$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ 为具有 $C^1$ 边界的有界区域, 给定 $f\in L^2(\Omega)$. 若函数\[u\in H^2(\Omega)\]在 $L^2(\Omega)$ 中满足 \eqref{eq:neumann-classical-divergence-equation}, 且在 $\partial\Omega$ 上按迹的意义满足 \eqref{eq:neumann-homogeneous-conormal-boundary-condition}, 则称其为 Neumann 问题的\textbf{强解}.

blocks.en: A few comments are in order.\begin{enumerate}\item Of course, we have constructed things so that every strong solution of the Neumann problem is also a weak solution.\item In the construction of the weak form, the boundary conditions ``disappear\textquotesingle\textquotesingle; i.e., condition \eqref{eq:neumann-homogeneous-conormal-boundary-condition} does not appear explicitly in either the bilinear form or the space of admissible functions. Because of this, Neumann conditions are referred to as \emph{natural boundary conditions}. In fact, since the trace theorem does not guarantee the existence of normal derivatives of $H^1(\Omega)$ functions, it does not necessarily make sense to evaluate the boundary condition \eqref{eq:neumann-homogeneous-conormal-boundary-condition} on a weak solution of \eqref{eq:weak-neumann-variational-equation}.\item We have assumed that the data $f$ is in the space $L^2(\Omega)$. This can be weakened, for instance by taking $f\in L^2(S)$ where $S$ is a smooth surface contained in $\Omega$. However, we cannot take arbitrary data in $H^{-1}(\Omega)$ as we did for the Dirichlet problem.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 有必要作几点说明.\begin{enumerate}\item 当然, 上述构造保证 Neumann 问题的每个强解也都是弱解.\item 在弱形式的构造中, 边界条件 ``消失\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 了; 即条件 \eqref{eq:neumann-homogeneous-conormal-boundary-condition} 既不显式出现在双线性型中, 也不显式出现在容许函数空间中. 因而称 Neumann 条件为\emph{自然边界条件}. 事实上, 由于迹定理不保证 $H^1(\Omega)$ 函数的法向导数存在, 在 \eqref{eq:weak-neumann-variational-equation} 的弱解上计算边界条件 \eqref{eq:neumann-homogeneous-conormal-boundary-condition} 未必有意义.\item 假设了数据 $f$ 属于空间 $L^2(\Omega)$. 这一条件可以减弱, 例如可取 $f\in L^2(S)$, 其中 $S$ 为包含在 $\Omega$ 中的光滑曲面. 然而, 不能像 Dirichlet 问题那样取 $H^{-1}(\Omega)$ 中的任意数据.\end{enumerate}
